payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation systems, particularly for low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) is used for subword segmentation to alleviate the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
The mix-source method utilizes monolingual data of the target language to improve translation quality by mixing it with original source sentences.
Segmenting words into sub-components allows NMT to learn translations with fewer data, enhancing performance in low-resourced settings.
